status: FROZEN 2026-11-15 before any endpoint, sensor channel, setpoint log or stage file of a listed test was opened. Scoring set: tiers A1, A2, A3 (26 tests); tier B1 is listed for completeness and is not scored by F2. Draft text: DRAFT, not frozen
rule: Flame Design (PSI-10) tests that no release has scored and whose endpoint was never measured. Every day of CFI-G and Flame Design is already in a spent partition, so these are the tests the transfer rule excluded on those days, chosen from the table conditions, the script parameter file and the listing only (no channel, setpoint log, TP stamp, comment or after-test column read). Tier A can be scored by acme_normal/acme_inverse.wsp12 F2 once its conditions are written to a cases file; tier B needs a conversion or a law that F2 does not carry. Group = test day; partition_of_day is the PSI-10 split of that day, which this batch does not change. Held: no outcome is read until the batch and its release list are frozen.
caveats: On a ramp-to-zero test the flame_design.py label rule calls the end operator_termination whenever the scripted ramp starts before the flame ends, so tier A1 mostly tests the planned stop (first flow change 5-29 s after onset), not extinction physics.

The day-level PDFs (test sheets, flow traces, daily test point logs) and the _Comments.txt files of these days are published and may describe outcomes; nothing records whether anyone read them for these tests.
Tier A2 needs flame_design.py to run without _TP.txt (the flow-on fallback used for s-Flame); the transfer rule requires it today.
Sibling conditions copy mass flow, fuel fraction and Tad of an included test with identical script setpoints; Tad is not corrected for the O2 difference between the two tests.

tiers.A1: scripted short constant stage then ramp to zero; test flows equal to an included constant-flow test (sibling) of the same family
tiers.A2: constant flow, table conditions complete and inside the F2 domain; excluded only because the _TP.txt stage file is missing
tiers.A3: inverse, scripted multi-stage flows (v2); stage-1 flows equal to an included sibling
tiers.B1: scripted ignition-to-test ramp (flows still changing at the cutoffs), or no sibling: conditions need a GCF conversion, and a ramp or dilution law that F2 does not carry

no_table_row.why: raw files published but no row in the experiment table: no O2/Tad, and whether a hot flame was established is unknown without reading channels
